from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if (sr, sc) in seen or grid[sr][sc] == 8:
                continue
            stack = [(sr, sc)]
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                cells.append((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] != 8:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            colored = [(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in colored), max(r for r,c in colored)
            c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in colored), max(c for r,c in colored)
            tile = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
            ph, pw = len(tile), len(tile[0])
            for r,c in cells:
                out[r][c] = tile[(r-r0) % ph][(c-c0) % pw]
    return out
'''
file=program_dir/'task-f9f87c5f.py'
file.write_text(source)
print(file)
